{'text': 'Apple 正為 HomePod mini 以及第二代大 HomePod 推出一項名為 Sound Glow 的新功能。它會根據當前播放歌曲的專輯封面，以相應顏色點亮喇叭的觸控面板，說不定能為派對增添額外的氣氛。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple is rolling out a new feature for HomePod mini and the second-gen big HomePod called Sound Glow. This lights up the touch surface of your speaker with colors that reference the album artwork of the currently playing song, perhaps adding some additional ambience to a party vibe.'}

{'text': '以下是如何啟用新的 Sound Glow 功能……', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s how to enable the new Sound Glow feature …'}

{'text': 'Sound Glow 支援 HomePod mini 和 HomePod mini，以及第二代 HomePod。只有初代大 HomePod 不受支援。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sound Glow is supported by HomePod mini and HomePod mini, and the second-generation HomePod. Only the original big HomePod is excluded.'}

{'text': 'Sound Glow 會根據播放內容顯示動態環境燈光效果，所以必須播放帶有專輯封面的音樂或 podcast 才能運作。實際效果是，你會看到封面中兩至三種主要顏色，這些色球在面板上跳動，呈現一些動態感。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sound Glow shows animated ambient light effects based on what’s playing, so you have to be playing music or a podcast with album artwork for it to work. In practice, you see two or three dominant colors from the artwork and these balls of color bounce around the surface to give a bit of motion.'}

{'text': 'HomePod「螢幕」的輸出亮度不算很高，但如果你將 HomePod 靠著白色牆壁擺放，即使在黑暗中無法看見 HomePod 頂部，牆面也會反射出可見的顏色光暈。', 'paragraph_context': 'The output brightness of a HomePod ‘screen’ is not that bright, but if you have the HomePod against a white wall, you get some visible color cast in a dark room even if you can’t see the top of the HomePod itself.'}

{'text': '如何在 HomePod 上啟用 Sound Glow', 'paragraph_context': 'How to enable Sound Glow on HomePod'}

{'text': '要啟用 Sound Glow，請確保將系統更新到最新版本 27.2（目前處於 release candidate 測試階段）。然後，開啟「家居」App，長按你的 HomePod 並向下捲動至設定。你會看到一個新增的 Sound Glow 開關，只需啟用它即可開始播放音樂並即時體驗效果。', 'paragraph_context': 'To enable Sound Glow, make sure to update to the latest software version 27.2 (currently in release candidate beta). Then, open the Home app, long-press on your HomePod and scroll down to the settings. There will be a new toggle for Sound Glow. Just enable it to activate and start playing music to see it in action.'}

{'text': '當 Apple TV 與 HomePod 配對後，你也可以透過 Apple TV 的控制中心啟用 Sound Glow。長按 Apple TV 遙控器，橫向滑動以選擇 HomePod 選單項目，然後點擊啟用或停用 Sound Glow。這裡很容易存取這功能，相當方便，因為這代表你在舉辦派對時可以快速開啟，而在一年中其他可能太礙眼的時間也能輕鬆關閉。', 'paragraph_context': 'You can also enable Sound Glow from the Control Center on an Apple TV, when paired to HomePods. Long-press on the Apple TV remote, scroll across to select the HomePod menu item, and then click to enable or disable Sound Glow. It’s quite handy that it is easily accessible here as that means you can quickly turn it on if you are hosting a party, and easily turn it off for the rest of the year when it might be too distracting.'}
